Expected: first drain returns [A, B, C], second drain returns []
  PASS  first_drain_returns_3
  PASS  first_drain_FIFO_order
  PASS  second_drain_returns_0 — no Runnable should be drained twice

[Test 3] postDelayed captures delay_ms (deterministic mode treats as 0)
